theorem.source_control: 4-Bounded Planar 3-Connected 3SAT is NP-hard/NP-complete in the cited planar SAT literature.
theorem.derived_lemma: If the clause-variable incidence graph is 3-vertex-connected, then the primal variable graph is 3-vertex-connected.
theorem.scope: CONNECTIVITY-ONLY POSITIVE HYPOTHESES. DOES NOT CLASSIFY THE FULL JANUS RIGID TORSO LANGUAGE.

keymaster_barrier.scope: 3-CONNECTIVITY BY ITSELF IS NOT A SAT TRACTABILITY THEOREM. A JANUS TORSO SOLVER MUST USE ADDITIONAL ALGEBRAIC/CROSS-LAYER STRUCTURE. THIS DOES NOT BLOCK SUCH A SOLVER.

authority.source: Kratochvil 1994 and later 4-bounded planar 3-connected SAT literature
